science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: The First Forge hummed ominously as the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea struck the outer hull, sending violent shudders through the hand-forged brass ribbing. Blinding, stuttering violet arcs of raw static danced across the heavy observation viewport, casting sharp shadows over the grease-stained workstations. The pungent scent of vaporized copper flux and thick ozone bit sharply into Silas's throat, while the oppressive, bone-shaking vibration resonated through his very boots, and the faint, metallic tang of ionized iron settled on his tongue. With the primary containment array buckling under the impossible strain, Silas hurriedly engaged the heavy master shunt lever to DEFEND the excess charge and shielded the delicate secondary relays behind a welded copper bulwark to CONCEAL them. Shouting over the deafening hum that seemed to CONSUME all other sound, he shoved the sparking, heavily insulated calibration baton firmly into Hector's waiting grasp, demanding he finish the ascent.
